policy: Source conflict is not a license to infer safe arrival. State ownership at the falls never demonstrates a public right-of-way across all intervening parcels, a legal lot, a continuous trail, current road opening or safe conditions.

points.name: Conflicting older tourism point, not usable for arrival

evidence.detail: Michigan DNR LOTS parcel intersection of GIS #12 records ParID 258918, dedicated state-managed 47.8-acre Crystal Falls Management Unit parcel. This proves only the land at the mapped point, not public access from road.

Iron County 2022–2026 recreation inventory (adopted Jan 2022), Crystal Falls Township section, labels Chicaugon Falls Scenic and owner Private. County inventory is not a 2026 parcel-level title search. The inventory and DNR point intersect evidence require reconciliation.

Iron County Economic Chamber describes US-2 / Long Lake Road / Raymer or Dave's Camp Road and a walk following signs, warning of washouts. Signs and travel advice do not establish legal full-length public access or a safe designated lot.
A local visitor account notes private camps beside the route. Private camps do not prove the travel lane is private, but require road/right-of-way and hiking-easement verification.

DNR Crystal Falls Compartment 12139 report says private owners control almost all vehicle access into that compartment. This historic compartment-level statement is not a deed or falls-specific approach map.

Iron County Road Commission posts road closure updates and contact information but no source-backed Raymer or Dave's Camp road classification, public right-of-way or designated parking proof has been established in this review.

DNR publishes county forest road designations and warns that an open state forest road alone does not confer access to adjoining private property; no validated Raymer-to-falls connected public route derived.

The March 2026 Road Commission geographical atlas distinguishes county roads, other roads, public land and private ownership and cautions readers against trespass. No selected public parking/continuous pedestrian easement is proved by the countywide legend alone.

nextAuthorityActions.question: Is Raymer Drive / Dave's Camp Road a currently maintained or legally public road/right-of-way and what is its terminal legal extent? Is there an approved public waterfall visitor parking area or signed road restriction?

nextAuthorityActions.agency: Michigan DNR Crystal Falls Management Unit
nextAuthorityActions.question: Does a mapped public walking access corridor or easement connect legal parking to ParID 258918, including intervening private camps? Are signs and foot route managed or currently closed?

nextAuthorityActions.agency: Iron County Equalization / Register of Deeds
nextAuthorityActions.question: What current deeds, road dedication and parcel geometry substantiate the 2022 private scenic inventory listing versus DNR title at falls and along approach? Are public easements recorded?
